title: Final Fantasy Tactics: The War of the Lions

info.about: Final Fantasy Tactics: The War of the Lions is a 2007 tactical role-playing game developed and published by Square Enix for the PlayStation Portable (PSP).
info.trivia: A retranslation of the PlayStation classic with new cutscenes and characters.
info.why: Sold well and was ported to phones, so prices are moderate.
